# media-element

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: A media element's requests the browser may refuse, with every refusal a value: playMedia(el) answers playing or refused (no-gesture / overtaken / source-failed with the element's MediaError, which its error event already reports) and throws only a MediaPlayError carrying the caller's stack and the element's state; videoPipSupport(doc?) answers unsupported or supported with request(video) → entered | refused. Its lint rules (no-raw-media-play, no-raw-request-picture-in-picture) send every other HTMLMediaElement .play() promise and .requestPictureInPicture() call here.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `media/media-session`
    - `media/player`
- Exemptions:
  - Exempts itself from:
    - `media-element/no-raw-media-play` — `web/internal/media-play.ts` (sanctioned)
    - `media-element/no-raw-request-picture-in-picture` — `web/internal/video-pip.ts` (sanctioned)
  - Exempted by: `primitives/dom/media-element` (0 debt)
- Web:
  - Exports (types):
    - `PlayOutcome`
    - `VideoPipOutcome`
    - `VideoPipSupport`
  - Exports (values):
    - `MediaPlayError`
    - `playMedia`
    - `videoPipSupport`
